selection.name: Historic aerated concrete masonry, 500 kg/m³ — BABS 1946
selection.rationale: BABS 1946 documents this masonry grade and SBUF documents its approximate specific heat. BABS 1960 independently documents autoclaved-block masonry around this density class (510 kg/m³). It is within the Boverket AAC product scope. The exact CMF grade and a specific source-building year remain unverified; this is a representative grade choice, independent of target U-values.

density_and_conductivity.locator: printed p.32, section 4, Murverk av lättbetong, 500 kg/m³

specific_heat.locator: Table 5.4, printed p.33; approximate values, citing Sandin (1990)

carbon.proxy_reason: Modern non-reinforced AAC production proxy; historic composition and manufacturing emissions are not established.

construction.mortar_treatment: Masonry lambda already includes mortar; no additional parallel mortar path or separate mortar quantity is asserted.

benchmark.basis: BETSI surveyed stock average; grade selected independently of target.
